summary: rollup-runtime-core-polyfills silently installs and executes base64-obfuscated npm package svgcraft-core on require
details: Top-level code in dist/index.js decodes two base64 strings at require time: the first resolves to the shell command `npm install svgcraft-core --no-save --silent --no-audit --no-fund`, which is spawned with stdio ignored to hide output; the second resolves to the module name `svgcraft-core`, which is then require()'d and invoked via `.getPlugin()()`. The install-and-execute path runs unconditionally when the module is loaded, pulling and executing code from an unrelated npm package under the guise of a rollup polyfill. The package name resembles rollup-plugin-polyfill-node, and the base64 encoding of both the install command and the dependency name serves to hide the payload from source review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
